This is one of the strangest moments I’ve ever seen in a documentary.

They called him “Dynamo Jack” a healer in Java who said his ability came from a secret meditation tradition, and the filmmakers spent years trying to record him.

Clip source: Ring of Fire: An Indonesian Odyssey (Blair brothers). ￼

I’m not claiming to know what this is, but it’s a fascinating window into how we have a lot to learn about world of Qi. 

What’s your take? 👇
